audit_items.summary: Transaction loop continuation logic could benefit from explicit documentation about error handling semantics

counterexample.preconditions: N/A - Behavior is correct but underdocumented
attack_sequence: Attempted: partial block execution attack - not possible due to immediate return on error
Attempted: transaction skip via error injection - errors abort processing as intended
Attempted: selective execution - all or nothing semantics enforced
counterexample.expected_outcome: Correct behavior - any transaction error invalidates entire block

evidence.phase1_static: Lines 117-119: 'if err != nil { return nil, fmt.Errorf(...) }' - immediate return on error. This is CORRECT for block processing as all transactions must succeed for consensus.
evidence.phase2_counterexample_attempts: Tried: selective transaction execution (not possible), error suppression (errors propagated correctly), partial state commitment (state not committed on error). All attempts failed.
evidence.phase3_guard_search: Error return prevents partial block execution. Guard strength: STRONG - prevents consensus divergence.
evidence.recommendation: Consider adding comment explaining why errors are fatal to block processing

audit_items.summary: Nonce increment logic is correct but lacks explicit documentation about its persistence across execution failures

attack_sequence: Attempted: nonce replay after failed tx - nonce still incremented
Attempted: nonce manipulation via revert - nonce increment persists
Attempted: nonce decrement attack - no decrement path exists
counterexample.expected_outcome: Nonce correctly incremented and persists regardless of execution outcome

evidence.phase1_static: Line 451: 'st.state.SetNonce(msg.From, st.state.GetNonce(msg.From)+1)' - nonce increment occurs before EVM execution and persists on failure.
evidence.phase2_counterexample_attempts: Tried: nonce replay attack (nonce incremented before execution), revert-based manipulation (nonce outside revert scope), race condition (single-threaded).
evidence.phase3_guard_search: Nonce increment is permanent and occurs at correct position in state transition. Guard strength: STRONG.
evidence.recommendation: Add comment documenting nonce persistence semantics for clarity

evidence.counterexample_attempts: Tried: sender recovery bypass (types.Sender called at line 201), gas price overflow (big.Int used), nil value handling (nil checks present), EIP-1559 gas price miscalculation (lines 194-199 correctly compute effectiveGasPrice = min(baseFee + gasTipCap, gasFeeCap)), type confusion (tx.Type() correctly dispatched)
evidence.guard_identified: TransactionToMessage at lines 176-203 performs complete field mapping. Sender recovery via types.Sender (line 201) uses secp256k1. GasPrice calculation at lines 194-199: msg.GasPrice.Add(msg.GasTipCap, baseFee) then capped to GasFeeCap. All tx types handled via tx accessor methods.
evidence.guard_strength: STRONG - secp256k1 signature verification in types.Sender is cryptographically secure. big.Int prevents overflow. Field mapping is complete.
evidence.analysis: All 5 attack vectors analyzed. Input Validation: sender recovered cryptographically. State Transition: message struct properly initialized. Resource Exhaustion: no unbounded operations. Error Handling: errors returned from types.Sender. Concurrency: no shared mutable state.

evidence.counterexample_attempts: Tried: context override between transactions (SetTxContext called per transaction at state_processor.go:114), log misattribution (thash and txIndex set before any log emission), hash collision (SHA3 hashes are collision-resistant), index overflow (int type, block limited to reasonable tx count)
evidence.guard_identified: SetTxContext at statedb.go:980 stores thash and ti. Called at state_processor.go:114 'statedb.SetTxContext(tx.Hash(), i)' before ApplyTransactionWithEVM. AddLog uses these stored values.
evidence.guard_strength: STRONG - context set atomically before transaction execution. No race condition possible as single-threaded execution.
evidence.analysis: All 5 attack vectors analyzed. Input Validation: tx.Hash() is deterministic. State Transition: context set before execution. Resource Exhaustion: constant-time operation. Error Handling: no error paths. Concurrency: single-threaded block processing.

evidence.counterexample_attempts: Tried: partial state commit (snapshot/revert pattern used), state corruption on failure (RevertToSnapshot at evm.go:307,362,406,461), gas accounting bypass (initial gas tracked at line 304), atomicity violation (single transaction execution per call)
evidence.guard_identified: ApplyMessage at line 212-215 calls stateTransition.execute(). Snapshot taken at evm.go:259 before Call execution. RevertToSnapshot called on error (evm.go:307). State changes atomic within transaction boundary.
evidence.guard_strength: STRONG - snapshot/revert pattern ensures atomicity. All EVM operations occur within single execution context. Failed transactions revert all state except gas consumption.
evidence.analysis: All 5 attack vectors analyzed. Input Validation: preCheck at line 440. State Transition: atomic via snapshot. Resource Exhaustion: gas limits enforced. Error Handling: proper revert. Concurrency: single-threaded execution.

evidence.counterexample_attempts: Tried: status inversion (result.Failed() correctly checked at 191), cumulative gas overflow (uint64 addition at 176), log omission (GetLogs called at 210), bloom filter manipulation (CreateBloom at 211)
evidence.guard_identified: MakeReceipt at lines 186-216. Status set based on result.Failed() at lines 191-195. CumulativeGasUsed set from usedGas parameter (line 190). Logs retrieved via statedb.GetLogs (line 210). Bloom created from logs (line 211).
evidence.guard_strength: STRONG - receipt construction uses verified execution result. Status is binary based on execution outcome. Logs are deep-copied from state.
evidence.analysis: All 5 attack vectors analyzed. Receipt construction is deterministic from execution result. No race conditions in single-threaded processing.

evidence.counterexample_attempts: Tried: state leakage between transactions (each tx starts with committed prior state), snapshot contamination (fresh snapshot per tx), accumulated error masking (any error returns immediately)
evidence.guard_identified: After ApplyTransactionWithEVM at line 115, state is finalized per transaction. Line 120 appends receipt. No cross-transaction state leakage.
evidence.guard_strength: STRONG - each transaction execution is isolated. State changes committed atomically per transaction.
evidence.analysis: All 5 attack vectors analyzed. Post-transaction state is correct and isolated.

evidence.counterexample_attempts: Tried: early loop termination (only on error which invalidates block), transaction skip (range iteration complete), receipts count mismatch (append called for each tx at line 120), parallel processing race (sequential iteration)
evidence.guard_identified: Line 109: 'for i, tx := range block.Transactions()' iterates all transactions. Line 120: 'receipts = append(receipts, receipt)' for each successful transaction. Loop completes when all processed.
evidence.guard_strength: STRONG - Go range guarantees complete iteration. Receipts slice grows with each transaction.
evidence.analysis: All 5 attack vectors analyzed. Transaction iteration is complete. All transactions processed before system calls.

evidence.counterexample_attempts: Tried: system call ordering violation (lines 128,132,136 in correct order), SYSTEM_ADDRESS spoofing (hardcoded params.SystemAddress at 241,265,305), request omission (all three EIPs processed), state corruption (Finalise called after each system call)
evidence.guard_identified: Prague check at line 125. ParseDepositLogs (EIP-6110) at 128. ProcessWithdrawalQueue (EIP-7002) at 132. ProcessConsolidationQueue (EIP-7251) at 136. All use params.SystemAddress as caller.
evidence.guard_strength: STRONG - system calls use hardcoded SystemAddress. Order is deterministic. All Prague EIPs processed in specified order.
evidence.analysis: All 5 attack vectors analyzed. System calls execute after user transactions. No external input manipulation possible for system calls.

evidence.counterexample_attempts: Tried: reward manipulation (beacon engine has no block rewards post-merge), pre-finalization state access (Finalize called after all processing), state root computation timing (Finalize before result return)
evidence.guard_identified: Line 142: 'p.chain.Engine().Finalize(p.chain, header, tracingStateDB, block.Body())'. Called after all transactions and system calls. Beacon consensus engine applies no rewards (post-merge).
evidence.guard_strength: STRONG - Finalize is called at correct point in processing. No rewards in PoS. State root computed after Finalize.
evidence.analysis: All 5 attack vectors analyzed. Finalization order is correct. No exploitable timing window.

evidence.counterexample_attempts: Tried: state root mismatch acceptance (comparison at line 1760), root computation bypass (IntermediateRoot called), timing attack (root computed after all mutations complete)
evidence.guard_identified: State root computed via statedb.IntermediateRoot(). Compared against block.Root() from header. Mismatch returns error invalidating block.
evidence.guard_strength: STRONG - Merkle Patricia Trie root is cryptographic commitment to entire state. Any state difference produces different root.
evidence.analysis: All 5 attack vectors analyzed. State root verification is cryptographically secure.

evidence.counterexample_attempts: Tried: valid bypass with mismatched roots (comparison strict), partial validation acceptance (all checks must pass), receipt root bypass (receipt root also verified)
evidence.guard_identified: Block validity requires: all transactions execute successfully, state root matches, receipt root matches, gas used matches header. All conditions enforced.
evidence.guard_strength: STRONG - multiple cryptographic commitments verified. Any mismatch invalidates block.
evidence.analysis: All 5 attack vectors analyzed. Block validity checks are comprehensive.

evidence.counterexample_attempts: Tried: invalid block acceptance (error returned on any mismatch), state corruption on rejection (no state committed for invalid blocks), partial rollback (full rollback on any error)
evidence.guard_identified: Invalid blocks return error without state commitment. Transactional state used during processing. No partial state persisted on failure.
evidence.guard_strength: STRONG - invalid blocks cause full rejection. No state persisted. Error propagated to caller.
evidence.analysis: All 5 attack vectors analyzed. Invalid block handling is correct.
